title_sq: Apartament 2+1 me qira tek Eleonora te Kodra e Diellit
description_sq:
Apartament ne shitje
Shitet apartament 2+1 prane hotel Queen.
Apartamenti organizohet ne sallon ndenje bashke me kuzhinen.
Dy dhoma gjumi,dy ballkone dhe nje tualet.
Ndodhet ne katin e 5-te, pa ashensor.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for rent at Eleonora in Kodra e Diellit
description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 apartment for sale near the Queen hotel. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchen. Two bedrooms, two balconies and a bathroom. It is located on the 5th floor, without an elevator.
